questions.question: 'ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು' - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯು ಯಾವ ಕಾಲವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಹಿಂದೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ, ಮುಗಿಯದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ – ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಭೂತಕಾಲ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q1

questions.question:
ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಂಧಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಅ
(a) ವಧೂಪೇತ
(b) ಊರೂರು
(c) ಜಗಜ್ಯೋತಿ
(d) ಮಳೆಗಾಲ
ಬ
(i) ಆದೇಶ ಸಂಧಿ
(ii) ಶ್ಚುತ್ವ ಸಂಧಿ
(iii) ಲೋಪಸಂಧಿ
(iv) ಸವರ್ಣ ದೀರ್ಘಸಂಧಿ

options.A: a – iv, b – iii, c – ii, d – i
options.B: a – i, b – iv, c – iii, d – ii
options.C: a – ii, b – i, c – iv, d – iii
options.D: a – iii, b – ii, c – i, d – iv

questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ವಧೂ+ಉಪೇತ – ಸವರ್ಣ ದೀರ್ಘ; ಊರು+ಊರು – ಲೋಪ; ಜಗತ್+ಜ್ಯೋತಿ – ಶ್ಚುತ್ವ; ಮಳೆ+ಕಾಲ – ಆದೇಶ (ಕ → ಗ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q2

questions.question: 'ಅಂಗೈ' ಎಂಬ ಸಮಾಸ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿಗ್ರಹ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕೈಯ ಅಡಿ = ಅಂಗೈ (ಅಂಶಿ ಸಮಾಸ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q3

questions.question: ಈ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಪದದ ಪದ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಮಾರಿಗೆ + ಔತಣ = ಮಾರಿಗೌತಣ (ವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸಂಧಿ). ಉಳಿದವುಗಳ ವಿಭಜನೆ ತಪ್ಪು (ಭೇದ + ಇಲ್ಲ, ಕೇಡು + ಆದುದು). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q4

questions.question: 'ಚರಿತದಿಂದಭಿಷೇಕಮಂ' ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪದ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಚರಿತದಿಂದ + ಅಭಿಷೇಕಮಂ (ಲೋಪ ಸಂಧಿ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q5

questions.question: ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯು ತತ್ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಇದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದದ ಕಾಲ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಈಗ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ – ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ವರ್ತಮಾನ (ಉದಾ: ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q6

questions.question:
ಮೊದಲೆರಡು ಪದಗಳಿಗಿರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧದಂತೆ, ಮೂರನೇ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಪದ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಮುಪ್ಪೊಳಲು : ದ್ವಿಗು ಸಮಾಸ :: ಹೊರ ಬಾಗಿಲು : ?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಹೊರಗೆ = ಹೊರಬಾಗಿಲು – ಪೂರ್ವಪದ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾದ ಅಂಶಿ ಸಮಾಸ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q7

questions.question:
ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಅ
(a) ತಲೆದೂಗು
(b) ಕತ್ತಿಮಸೆ
(c) ಎರಡು ಬಗೆ
(d) ಕಟ್ಟುಕತೆ
ಬ
(i) ಹಗೆ ಸಾಧಿಸು
(ii) ಸುಳ್ಳುಮಾತು
(iii) ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಸೂಚಿಸು
(iv) ದ್ರೋಹ ಮಾಡು
(v) ಶರಣಾಗು

options.A: a – i, b – v, c – ii, d – iii
options.B: a – v, b – ii, c – i, d – iv
options.C: a – iii, b – i, c – iv, d – ii
options.D: a – iv, b – iii, c – i, d – v

questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ತಲೆದೂಗು = ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ; ಕತ್ತಿಮಸೆ = ಹಗೆ ಸಾಧಿಸು; ಎರಡು ಬಗೆ = ದ್ರೋಹ; ಕಟ್ಟುಕತೆ = ಸುಳ್ಳುಮಾತು. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q8

questions.question: 'ಆಳಲೆ ಕಾಯಿ ಪಂಡಿತ' ಎಂಬ ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟಿನ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಳಲೆಕಾಯಿ ಪಂಡಿತ = ಸ್ವಲ್ಪವೇ ತಿಳಿದು ವೈದ್ಯನೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವವನು, ನಕಲಿ ವೈದ್ಯ (KEA ಅಂತಿಮ ಕೀ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q9

questions.question:
ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥಗಳ ಯಾವ ಜೋಡಿಗಳು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿವೆ? ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
(a) ಚತುರ್ಥೀ – ಸಂಪ್ರದಾನ
(b) ಸಪ್ತಮೀ – ಅಧಿಕರಣ
(c) ಪಂಚಮೀ – ಕರ್ಮಾರ್ಥ
(d) ಷಷ್ಠೀ – ಅಪಾದಾನ
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಪಂಚಮೀ – ಅಪಾದಾನ, ಷಷ್ಠೀ – ಸಂಬಂಧ; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ a ಮತ್ತು b ಮಾತ್ರ ಸರಿ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q10

questions.question: ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷಾ ರಚನೆಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪದೆ ಇರುವ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಾಂಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ/ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪ್ರಭಾವ; ಕನ್ನಡದ ಸಹಜ ರಚನೆ ಕರ್ತರಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q11

questions.question: ಮುಂದಿನ ಯಾವ ಪದ ಅನ್ಯದೇಶ್ಯ ಪದವಲ್ಲ?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಹಿತ್ತಿಲು ಅಚ್ಚಗನ್ನಡ ಪದ; ರೈತ, ಕಸುಬು, ಖಾಯಿಲೆ ಅರಬ್ಬಿ/ಪಾರಸಿ ಮೂಲದವು. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q12

questions.question: 'ಕರ್ಣಾಟಕ ಕವಿ ಚೂತವನ ಚೈತ್ರ' ಎಂಬ ಬಿರುದನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದ ಕವಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಜೈಮಿನಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕವಿ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಶ – ಕರ್ಣಾಟಕ ಕವಿ ಚೂತವನ ಚೈತ್ರ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q13

questions.question:
ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಅ
(a) ಶಾಂತಿನಾಥ
(b) ಹರಿಹರ
(c) ಚಾಮರಸ
(d) ಮಹಲಿಂಗರಂಗ
(e) ಲಿಂಗರಾಜ
ಬ
(i) ಪ್ರಭುಲಿಂಗ ಲೀಲೆ
(ii) ನರಪತಿ ವಿಜಯ
(iii) ಸುಕುಮಾರ ಚರಿತೆ
(iv) ಅನುಭವಾಮೃತ
(v) ಮುಡಿಗೆಯ ಅಷ್ಟಕ

options.A: a – i, b – ii, c – iii, d – v, e – iv
options.B: a – iv, b – ii, c – v, d – iii, e – i
options.C: a – v, b – iv, c – ii, d – i, e – iii
options.D: a – iii, b – v, c – i, d – iv, e – ii

questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಶಾಂತಿನಾಥ – ಸುಕುಮಾರ ಚರಿತೆ; ಹರಿಹರ – ಮುಡಿಗೆಯ ಅಷ್ಟಕ; ಚಾಮರಸ – ಪ್ರಭುಲಿಂಗ ಲೀಲೆ; ಮಹಲಿಂಗರಂಗ – ಅನುಭವಾಮೃತ; ಲಿಂಗರಾಜ – ನರಪತಿ ವಿಜಯ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q14

questions.question: ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೊಟ್ಟ ಮೊದಲ ವಿಶ್ವಕೋಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ನಿಜಗುಣ ಶಿವಯೋಗಿಯ ವಿವೇಕ ಚಿಂತಾಮಣಿ – ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೊದಲ ವಿಶ್ವಕೋಶ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q15

questions.question:
ಸೂಚನೆ : ಸ್ಥಾನಪಲ್ಲಟವಾಗಿರುವ ಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
ದೊರಕಲಿಲ್ಲ (a)   ಯಾವ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯೂ (b)   ಹೊಸಗನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ (c)   ತನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಿಂದ (d)
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಹೊಸಗನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಿಂದ ಯಾವ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯೂ ದೊರಕಲಿಲ್ಲ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q16

questions.question: ಮುಂದಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದು ಅ, ಆ, ಸ್ವರಗಳ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನವಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅ, ಆ ಕಂಠದಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟುವ ಕಂಠ್ಯ ಸ್ವರಗಳು. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q17

questions.question: ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರದ ಪದವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಉಳಿದವು ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಜೋಡಿಗಳು; ನೃಪ (ರಾಜ) ಮತ್ತು ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಬೇರೆ ಅರ್ಥ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q18

questions.question: 'ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ' ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ × ಏಕಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q19

questions.question: 'ಧಾತು'ವನ್ನು ಈ ಮುಂದಿನ ಹೆಸರಿನಿಂದ ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಧಾತು = ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದದ ಮೂಲ ರೂಪ, ಕ್ರಿಯಾ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q20

questions.question: ಈ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧಿತ ಧಾತು ಯಾವುದು?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಬ್ಬರ + ಇಸು = ಅಬ್ಬರಿಸು (ನಾಮಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಇಸು ಸೇರಿ ಆದ ಸಾಧಿತ ಧಾತು). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q21

questions.question: ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿರುಕ್ತಿ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕಡೆ+ಕಡೆ, ನಡುವೆ+ನಡುವೆ, ಮೊದಲು+ಮೊದಲು – ದ್ವಿರುಕ್ತಿ; (2) ಅನುಕರಣಾವ್ಯಯ, (3) ಜೋಡುನುಡಿ, (4) ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟು. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q22

questions.question:
ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಅ
(a) ಅಧ್ಯಾಹಾರ
(b) ಎಮಕೆ
(c) ಕಮಠ
(d) ಖೇಚರ
ಬ
(i) ಮೂಳೆ
(ii) ಗಂಧರ್ವ
(iii) ಊಹೆ
(iv) ಆಮೆ

options.A: a – iii, b – i, c – iv, d – ii
options.B: a – i, b – iv, c – ii, d – iii
options.C: a – iv, b – iii, c – ii, d – i
options.D: a – iii, b – i, c – ii, d – iv

questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಧ್ಯಾಹಾರ = ಊಹೆ; ಎಮಕೆ = ಮೂಳೆ; ಕಮಠ = ಆಮೆ; ಖೇಚರ = ಗಂಧರ್ವ (ಆಕಾಶಗಾಮಿ). (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)
questions.source: Legislative Council 2024 Asst/Jr Asst P2 · Q23

questions.question:
ಮೊದಲೆರಡು ಪದಗಳಿಗಿರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧದಂತೆ, ಮೂರನೇ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಪದ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.
ಖೇಚರ : ಪಕ್ಷಿ :: ಕಾರ್ಪಾಸ : ?
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)

questions.explanation: ಗಮಕ ಸಮಾಸ (ಉದಾ: ಆ ಮನೆ) ಕರ್ಮಧಾರಯದ ಒಂದು ಬಗೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಭಿಕ್ಷುಕರು ಮನೆಮನೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿ ಭಿಕ್ಷೆ ಬೇಡಿದರು. ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ ಎಳೆದ ಪದದ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ: (ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ: ಮನೆಮನೆಗಳನ್ನು)
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಒಂದೇ ಪದ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ (ಮನೆ ಮನೆ) – ದ್ವಿರುಕ್ತಿ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಉದ್ದಂಡ ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಚನೆಯಾಗಿರುವ ರಾಘವಾಂಕನ ಕಾವ್ಯ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ರಾಘವಾಂಕನ ವೀರೇಶ ಚರಿತೆ ಉದ್ದಂಡ ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ:
a) ತ್ರಿಪದಿ
b) ಶರ್ಕರಾ
c) ಅಕ್ಷರ
d) ಕಾವ್ಯ
i) ಕಬ್ಬ
ii) ಅಕ್ಕರ
iii) ಸಕ್ಕರೆ
iv) ತಿವದಿ

options.A: a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - i
options.B: a - ii, b - i, c - iv, d - iii
options.C: a - iii, b - iv, c - i, d - ii
options.D: a - i, b - ii, c - iii, d - iv

questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ತತ್ಸಮ–ತದ್ಭವ: ತ್ರಿಪದಿ–ತಿವದಿ, ಶರ್ಕರಾ–ಸಕ್ಕರೆ, ಅಕ್ಷರ–ಅಕ್ಕರ, ಕಾವ್ಯ–ಕಬ್ಬ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಭೂಮಿ, ಬಾನು, ಬೋನ, ಬಾಯಿ – ಈ ಶಬ್ದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರದ ಪದ ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಭೂಮಿ ತತ್ಸಮ (ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ) ಪದ; ಉಳಿದವು ಕನ್ನಡ ಪದಗಳು (KEA ಅಂತಿಮ ಕೀ). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಒಂದು ಸಾವಿರದ ಒಂಬೈನೂರ ಎಂಬತ್ತ್ಮೂರು ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡ ಅಂಕಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: 1983 = ೧೯೮೩. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಪುರದ ಪುಣ್ಯಂ ಪುರುಷ ರೂಪಿಂದೆ ಪೋಗುತಿದೆ, ಪರಿಜನದ ಭಾಗ್ಯವಡವಿಗೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿದೆ” ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಲಂಕಾರ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ರಾಮನನ್ನೇ ಪುರದ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಅಭೇದವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ರೂಪಕಾಲಂಕಾರ (KEA ಕೀ). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಅವನು ಆನೆಯಷ್ಟು ದಪ್ಪಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ ಎಳೆದ ಶಬ್ದದ ವಿಶೇಷತೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿ. (ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ: ಆನೆಯಷ್ಟು)
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಷ್ಟು/ಇಷ್ಟು – ಗಾತ್ರ, ಅಳತೆ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಪರಿಮಾಣವಾಚಕ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಹಂಸ' ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ________
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಹಂಸ → ಅಂಚೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಗಾಣ + ಇಗ = ಗಾಣಿಗ ಇಲ್ಲಿ 'ಇಗ' ಎಂಬುದು:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: KEA ಅಂತಿಮ ಕೀ ಉತ್ತರ (1) ಅವ್ಯಯ. ಗಮನಿಸಿ: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 'ಇಗ' ತದ್ಧಿತ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಸಾಬೂನು ________ ಭಾಷೆಯಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಶಬ್ದ
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಸಾಬೂನು ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸ್ ಮೂಲದ ಅನ್ಯದೇಶ್ಯ ಪದ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ವರಗಳು ಸೇರಿ ________ ಎನಿಸುವುದು
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕ್ + ಅ = ಕ, ಕ್ + ಆ = ಕಾ … – ಗುಣಿತಾಕ್ಷರಗಳು. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರದ ಪದ ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಕ್ಷರ, ಜ್ಞಾನ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ (ಕ್ಷ/ಜ್ಞ ಇರುವ) ಪದಗಳು; ಅಕ್ಕ ಕನ್ನಡ ಪದ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ” ಕೃತಿಯ ಕರ್ತೃ
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ – ತೀ.ನಂ. ಶ್ರೀಕಂಠಯ್ಯ (KEA ಕೀ). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಹಣ್ಣು ರಾಮನಿಂದ ತಿನ್ನಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು' ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯವು ________ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕರ್ಮ (ಹಣ್ಣು) ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ಕರ್ತೃವಿಗೆ ತೃತೀಯಾ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ – ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಅತ್ಯಂತ, ಮನ್ವಂತರ, ಪಿತ್ರಾರ್ಜಿತ ಈ ಶಬ್ದಗಳು ________ ಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅತಿ+ಅಂತ, ಮನು+ಅಂತರ, ಪಿತೃ+ಆರ್ಜಿತ – ಇ/ಉ/ಋ ಗಳಿಗೆ ಯ್/ವ್/ರ್ ಆದೇಶ – ಯಣ್ ಸಂಧಿ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕಾವ್ಯಾರ್ಥ ಚಿಂತನ ಜಿ.ಎಸ್. ಶಿವರುದ್ರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಕೃತಿ; ತೀ.ನಂ.ಶ್ರೀ ಅವರದ್ದು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಾವ್ಯಮೀಮಾಂಸೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಕೇಶಿರಾಜನ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಶುದ್ಧಗೆಗಳೆಂದರೆ ________ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಶಿರಾಜ 47 ಶುದ್ಧಾಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾನೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಪ್ರಧಾನ' ಶಬ್ದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪದ ________
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಪ್ರಧಾನ × ಗೌಣ (ಮುಖ್ಯವಲ್ಲದ್ದು). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಸೂರ್ಯ' ಶಬ್ದದ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಶಬ್ದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪಾದುದನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಬಾನು = ಆಕಾಶ; ಭಾನು = ಸೂರ್ಯ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಕವಿ' ಪದದ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ ರೂಪ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೂಪ ಕವಯಿತ್ರಿ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ವಿಶ್ವಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕನ್ನಡವು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿರುವ ಕಾಣಿಕೆ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ವಚನ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡದ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಕೊಡುಗೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ದಯಾನಂದರು ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಗುರುವಿನ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಪಡೆದು, ವೈದಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಪ್ರಸಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದೇಶ ಸಂಚಾರ ಹೊರಟರು” ________ ವಾಕ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: KEA ಅಂತಿಮ ಕೀ ಉತ್ತರ: ಸಮ್ಮಿಶ್ರ ವಾಕ್ಯ (ಮುಗಿಸಿ, ಪಡೆದು ಎಂಬ ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಧಾನ ವಾಕ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಜಗನ್ನಾಥ ವಿಜಯ” ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಬರೆದವರು:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಜಗನ್ನಾಥ ವಿಜಯ – ರುದ್ರಭಟ್ಟ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ” ಎಂದು ಬಿರುದಾಂಕಿತನಾದ ಕವಿ:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ರಾಘವಾಂಕ – ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಎಂಜಲು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಗೆ ಓಡಿಸದವ” ಎಂದರೆ ________
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಎಂಜಲು ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಕಾಗೆಯನ್ನೂ ಓಡಿಸದವನು (ಅನ್ನದ ಅಗುಳು ಬಿದ್ದೀತೆಂದು) – ಜಿಪುಣ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: ಕಂದ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮಾತ್ರಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಕಂದ ಪದ್ಯ: 4 ಸಾಲು, 12+20+12+20 = 64 ಮಾತ್ರೆ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಈ ಹೊಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀನುಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು” ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ ಎಳೆದ ಶಬ್ದದಲ್ಲಿನ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ: (ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ: ಹೊಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ)
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಅಲ್ಲಿ – ಸಪ್ತಮೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ (ಅಧಿಕರಣ). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: “ಊರು ಉಪಕಾರ ಅರಿಯದು, ಹೆಣ ಶೃಂಗಾರ ಅರಿಯದು” ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅಲಂಕಾರ ________.
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ಒಂದು ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಸಮಾನವಾದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಕೊಡುವುದು – ದೃಷ್ಟಾಂತಾಲಂಕಾರ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: 'ಆ ಕರಡಿ ತನ್ನ ಪಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾನು ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಯಿತು' ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ತಾನು' ಎಂಬುದು:
questions.subject: Q1–35 (Kannada)
questions.explanation: ತಾನು, ತಾವು, ತನ್ನ – ಆತ್ಮಾರ್ಥಕ ಸರ್ವನಾಮ. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

The system of single marriage

questions.question:
A person who believes that people cannot know whether God exists or not is called ____

questions.subject: Q36–60

questions.subject: Q36–60

questions.subject: Q36–60

questions.explanation: 'if one is healthy' to match 'has'. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:

The superstar was known for his laconic answers. (underlined: laconic)
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Laconic = using few words. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
The following question has words designated as A B C D E and F which are jumbled up and need to be rearranged to form a proper sentence. Find out the correct sequence of the words and select the correct option as the answer.
A: always   B: coffee
C: to   D: like
E: have   F: you
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: You always like to have coffee. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:

questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Verb practise, noun practice. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

Choose the right option to fill in the blanks.

questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Council = body; counsel = advice. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:

After many attempts (a) / he gave out (b) / the idea of earning money (c) / through gambling (d).

questions.explanation: Sequence of tenses. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:

It was raining heavily. All the students wanted to go home early. Hence, they decided to send ____ student to ____ headmaster to seek permission.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Any one student; the particular headmaster. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Identify the correct form of tense in the following sentence:

questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Simple present for a scheduled future event. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Identify the correct form of tense in the following sentence:
I am going to ____ a holiday soon.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: going to + base verb. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Fill in the blanks with correct articles in the following sentences:
Smitha brought a lot of luggage with her. She got down. She left ____ luggage at ____ railway station.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Specific luggage and station. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Fill in the blanks with correct articles in the following sentence:
Suman is going to buy ____ hat and ____ umbrella.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: an before a vowel sound. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Choose the most suitable alternative to make the sentence logical.
The football match was ____ live across the nation.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Past participle is broadcast. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Choose the suitable interjection for the following sentence.
____!, I didn't expect to see you here.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Surprise. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Choose the most suitable alternative to make the sentence logical.
He ____ goes to the market.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Adverb of frequency. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question:
Read the sentence and choose the most appropriate meaning for the underlined idioms and phrases in the sentence.
The two parties decided to bury the hatchet and keep their relations healthy.
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Bury the hatchet = make peace. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: Choose the mis-spelt word:
questions.subject: Q36–60
questions.explanation: Auxiliary. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

The values of (X, Y, Z) in the table respectively are
[Table: row 1 – 16, X, total Y; row 2 – 20, 36, total 58; column totals – 36, Z, grand total 88]
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Y = 88 − 58 = 30; X = 30 − 16 = 14; Z = 14 + 36 = 50. (As printed, row 2 adds to 56, not 58; code (1) is the intended answer.) (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram from the given options which best represents the relationship among women, poets and politicians.
[Options: (1) three circles in a row, the middle one overlapping both; (2) three separate circles; (3) three circles one inside another; (4) three circles all overlapping one another]
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: A woman can be a poet and a politician; a man can be both too – all three sets overlap. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
A man is facing north-east. He turns 90° in the anti-clockwise direction and then 135° in the clockwise direction. Which direction is he facing now?
[Figure: a compass rose with an arrow towards N-E]
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: NE − 90° = NW; NW + 135° = East. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
In this question, a statement is followed by assumption numbered I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if they seem to be at variance from the commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the following assumptions logically follows from the given statement.
Statement: Suresh attempted Canara Bank exam and got selected for the post
Assumptions:
(I) Exam was very easy
(II) Suresh qualified in the exam

options.A: Both I and II are implicit
options.B: Neither I nor II is implicit

questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Selection implies he qualified; nothing says the exam was easy. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: If today is Tuesday, after 62 days it will be
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: 62 = 8 weeks + 6 days; Tuesday + 6 = Monday. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: In a cubical dice numbered 1 to 6, 2 is opposite to 3 and adjacent to 6 and 4, then which of the following statements is necessarily TRUE?
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Since 2 and 3 face each other, every other face – including 1 – touches both. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Weekly incomes of A and B are in the ratio 7:3 and their weekly expenses are in the ratio 5:2 respectively. The difference of their savings is ₹200. Weekly income of A is ₹5,600. Weekly expense of B is
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: B's income 2,400. (5600 − 5x) − (2400 − 2x) = 200 → x = 1000; B's expense 2x = 2,000. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 15 km/hr. It can go 30 km upstream and return downstream to the original point in 4 hours 30 minutes. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: 30/(15 − s) + 30/(15 + s) = 4.5 → 225 − s² = 200 → s = 5. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
What comes in the place of question mark (?) in the series given below?
147, 54, 48, 18, 15, 6,?
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Two series: 54, 18, 6 (÷3) and 147, 48, 15, ? (÷3 − 1): 15 ÷ 3 − 1 = 4. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: 'Project Glasswing' and 'Mythos Preview' AI models were recently in the news. They are associated with which major technology company?
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Anthropic announced Project Glasswing, giving partners its Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cyber-security work (2026). (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Devanuru Mahadeva:
(a) He is recently selected for the prestigious Pampa award for the year 2025-26.
(b) His literature is rooted in the Dalit and Bandaya movements of Kannada literature.
(c) He was honored with Kendra Sahitya Award for his novel 'Kusumabale'.
(d) In 2024, the Kerala Government honored him with the 'Vaikom Award' for social justice.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: The Vaikom Award for social justice that he received is given by the Tamil Nadu Government (first awarded in 2023), so (d) is wrong; Kusumabale won the Sahitya Akademi award (1990). (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Dr. Subhas C. Kashyap, an Indian political scientist, who was an expert in the Indian Constitution and constitutional law passed away on June 4, 2026.
Identify the incorrect statement/s about him.
(a) He was the Secretary-General of 7th, 8th and 9th Lok Sabha.
(b) He was honoured with Padma Bhushana award
(c) He was the Chairman of the high-level committee in the making of 'One-Nation, One-Election'.
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: (a) and (b) are true (Lok Sabha Secretary-General 1984–90; Padma Bhushan 2015). The One Nation, One Election committee was chaired by Ram Nath Kovind. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement/statements with regard to "EK Ped Maa Ke Naam" campaign.
(a) This campaign was inaguarated on June 5, 2026 on the occasion of World Environment Day.
(b) This campaign was inaugurated by planting of a peepal tree by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi at Buddha Jayanthi Park, New Delhi on June 5, 2024.
(c) This campaign aligns with the nation's quest for sustainable development.
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: It was launched on World Environment Day 2024, not 2026. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following statements with regard to 'Ashadeep' programme of Government of Karnataka.
(a) This programme is aimed at providing employment opportunities to OBC candidates in private sector
(b) Under this programme, employers are reimbursed ESI and EPF contribution up to ₹ 3000 per candidate per month for a period of 2 years.
(c) For newly recruited candidates, a wage reimbursement of Rs. 10,000 per month per candidate is provided for two years.
Which of the above statement/s is/are correct?
questions.subject: Q51–75
questions.explanation: Ashadeep (Social Welfare Department) helps SC/ST candidates, not OBCs, so only the code without (a) fits. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Quantum Research Park, a Hub for Quantum Computing and related technologies, is a project administered by 'Foundation for Science Innovation and Development'. Foundation for Science Innovation and Development is a part of

options.A: International Institute of Information Technology, Bengaluru
options.B: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: FSID is IISc's Section-8 company; Karnataka's Quantum Research Park is run through it. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Which of the following committee is NOT the standing committee of Taluk Panchayat?
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: A taluk panchayat has three standing committees: general; finance, audit and planning; social justice. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following statements related to public administration and select the correct answer using the given codes.
(i) Public Administration is important to lead a civilized life.
(ii) The functions performed by private sections are not so important as public sector
(iii) Public administration has monopoly over many subjects
(iv) Military, law and order are performed by private businessmen.
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Defence and law and order are state monopolies, not private business, so (iv) is false. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following statement/s related to budget, and find the correct answer using the given codes.
(i) Budget includes the Rule of Lapse system
(ii) Finance provided for one financial year can be used for another financial year
(iii) It leads to overexpenditure
(iv) In India, financial year ends on March 31
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Under the rule of lapse unspent money lapses at year-end (31 March), which causes the 'March rush' of spending. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
According to the National Legal Services Authority, the persons who are not eligible for getting free legal services include:
(a) Women and children and people belonging to SC/ST communities
(b) Industrial workmen and person in custody
(c) Disabled persons and human trafficking victim beggars
(d) Victims of mass disaster, flood, violence, drought, earthquake and industrial disaster
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: All four groups ARE eligible under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are CORRECT regarding the Prime Minister of India?
(a) President of India elects the Prime Minister of India
(b) The Prime Minister of India advises the President to dismiss a minister.
(c) The Prime Minister directs, controls and co-ordinates the activities of all the ministers.
(d) Prime Minister recommends persons who can be appointed as ministers
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: The President appoints (does not elect) the Prime Minister. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding Vice President of India is INCORRECT?

options.A: Only elected members of the Parliament vote in his/her election
options.B: He is ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha
options.C: The President of India administers oath of office to him/her
options.D: The members of state legislative assemblies do not participate in his/her election

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: All members of both Houses, elected and nominated, elect the Vice-President. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement I: The Advocate General has the right to speak in both the Houses of the State Legislature
Statement II: The Advocate General has the right to vote only in State Legislative Assembly

options.A: Both Statements I and II are correct and Statement II is related to Statement I
options.B: Both Statements I and II are correct and Statement II is not related to Statement I
options.C: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.D: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Article 177: the Advocate General may speak in either House but has no vote. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
The correct statements about Fundamental Rights are:
(a) They are enforceable in the courts of law
(b) These are absolute rights
(c) They can be suspended during national emergency, except some
(d) They are available only to Indian citizens.
Choose the correct answer.
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: They carry reasonable restrictions, Articles 20–21 survive an emergency, and some (14, 20, 21…) cover foreigners too. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Consider the following committees related to Electoral Reforms
(a) Indrajit Gupta Committee
(b) Vohra Committee
(c) Dinesh Goswami Committee
(d) Tarkunde Committee
Arrange the above Committees in chronological order
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Tarkunde 1974–75, Dinesh Goswami 1990, Vohra 1993, Indrajit Gupta 1998. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
"Sadunge sadu
Maduryange maduryam
Badippa kalige
Kaliyuga vipareethan
Madavaneethan peranalla"
Which dynasty's period does this inscription describe the qualities of Kannadigas belong to?
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Kappe Arabhatta's inscription at Badami (about AD 700) – the oldest tripadi verse. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Arrange the following in chronological order
(a) Kithuru Rani Chennamma's rebellion
(b) Dhondia Wagha's rebellion
(c) Halagali Bedas' rebellion
(d) Sangolli Rayanna's rebellion
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Dhondia Wagh 1800 → Kittur Chennamma 1824 → Sangolli Rayanna 1829–31 → Halagali Bedas 1857. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Match the following:
List-I (Organisations)
(a) International Labour Organisation (ILO)
(b) V.V. Giri National Labour Institute
(c) National Labour Bureau
(d) Institute for Social and Economic Change
List-II (Headquarter)
(i) Shimla
(ii) Bengaluru
(iii) Geneva
(iv) Noida
Codes:

options.A: a – i, b – ii, c – iii, d – iv
options.B: a – iii, b – iv, c – i, d – ii
options.C: a – ii, b – iii, c – iv, d – i
options.D: a – iv, b – iii, c – i, d – ii

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: ILO – Geneva; VVGNLI – Noida; Labour Bureau – Shimla (and Chandigarh); ISEC – Bengaluru. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: What is the contribution rate for an employee towards EPF?
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: 12% of basic pay plus DA (10% for some small or notified establishments). (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Amongst the five friends, Lata, Alka, Rani, Asha and Sahana, Lata is older than only three of her friends. Alka is younger to Asha and Lata. Rani is older than only Sahana. Who amongst them is eldest?
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Lata is 2nd, Rani 4th, Sahana 5th; Alka is younger than Lata, so 3rd; Asha is the eldest. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Which famous Indian artist's works are predominately displayed and celebrated at the 'Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum' in Vadodara, Gujarat?
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: The museum in the Lakshmi Vilas Palace grounds holds many Raja Ravi Varma paintings. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Nipah virus primarily spreads through
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Fruit bats (Pteropus) are the natural host; outbreaks have occurred in Kerala. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
The Strait of Hormuz is among the strategic natural channels. Which among the following are two man-made channels?
(a) Suez Canal
(b) Gibralter Strait
(c) Panama Canal
(d) Strait of Malacca
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Straits are natural; the Suez and Panama canals were dug. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Match the following operations in List-I with their purpose in List-II.
List - I (Operation)
(a) Operation Sindoor
(b) Operation Brahma
(c) Operation Ajay
(d) Operation Black Forest
List - II (Purpose)
(i) Anti-Naxal operations
(ii) Evacuation of Indian nationals during West Asia conflict
(iii) In response to the Pahalgam terror attack
(iv) Humanitarian assistance to Myanmar after a devastating earthquake
Codes:

options.A: a – iii, b – ii, c – i, d – iv
options.B: a – ii, b – iii, c – iv, d – i
options.C: a – iii, b – iv, c – ii, d – i
options.D: a – iii, b – ii, c – iv, d – i

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Sindoor (May 2025) – strikes after the Pahalgam attack; Brahma (March 2025) – Myanmar quake relief; Ajay (2023) – evacuation from Israel; Black Forest (2025) – anti-Naxal operation in the Karregutta hills. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: BIMSTEC stands for

options.A: Bay of International Maritime Security Trade Economic Cooperation
options.B: Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation
options.C: Border Initiative of Maritime and Trade Economic Cooperation
options.D: Bengal International Strategic Trade and Economic Council

questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Set up in 1997 (Bangkok Declaration), it has 7 members; the secretariat is in Dhaka. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
Identify the correct sequence with respect to longest unbroken tenures of India's democratically elected Prime Ministers as on 10th June, 2026. (Highest to Lowest)
(a) Jawaharlal Nehru
(b) Manmohan Singh
(c) Atal Bihari Vajpayee
(d) Narendra Modi
(e) Indira Gandhi
questions.subject: Q76–100
questions.explanation: Nehru ≈ 16 yr 9 mo (1947–64); Modi ≈ 12 yr (since May 2014; passed Indira's unbroken 11 yr 59 days in July 2025); Manmohan 10 yr; Vajpayee ≈ 6 yr (1998–2004). (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)
